name: Mainframe
author: Trance
description: Six traces on a circuit board, each carrying pulses of light that run faster the louder its range, between chips that light up with their own slice of the spectrum.
frame:
q0 = q0 + dt*0.30*(0.3 + sub_att)
q1 = q1 + dt*0.42*(0.3 + low_att)
q2 = q2 + dt*0.54*(0.3 + lowmid_att)
q3 = q3 + dt*0.66*(0.3 + highmid_att)
q4 = q4 + dt*0.78*(0.3 + presence_att)
q5 = q5 + dt*0.90*(0.3 + air_att)

layers.point:
s = t*10*0.9999
seg = floor(s)
f = s - seg
x = -1.7 + (0.34)*(floor((seg + 1)/2) + if(equal(mod(seg, 2), 0), f, 0))
y = -0.9 + (0.3)*(floor(seg/2) + if(equal(mod(seg, 2), 1), f, 0))
a = a*(0.35 + 0.65*smoothstep(0.6, 1, fract(t*3 - q0)))
